description: This file implements an Azure-specific client for interacting with Azure OpenAI services, including chat completions, image generation, embeddings, speech, and handling of request-response cycles with support for both synchronous and asynchronous operations. It defines classes and functions to facilitate API requests, handle responses, manage headers, and coordinate operations related to Azure OpenAI deployments, including specific support for image generation and DALL-E integration.
